measurement_4_NEW_scope_sensitivity_prob.status: NEW FINDING - the plain variable-wise R03 patch is not scope-safe
measurement_4_NEW_scope_sensitivity_prob.question: The W16-R03-ADJ-01 option table tests negative control V4 (clause binds NEITHER q nor t0), which is a coarse control. It does not test a SCOPE error, where both variables are literally present but the negation binds only the first.

variants_tested.frozen_variable_wise_intended_correct: not exists q in I+ and t0 in [0,T) with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M.
variants_tested.grouped_tuple_intended_correct: not exists (q,t0) in D5 with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M.
variants_tested.scope_error_negation_binds_q_only: not exists q in I+ with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M, and t0 in [0,T).

reading.baseline_on_scope_error: reject (but for the same missing-literal reason as the correct variable-wise rendering, so the baseline has no scope discriminative power either)
reading.conclusion: Neither the literal rule nor cand_E3 is scope-aware. The literal rule over-rejects (correct variable-wise rendering fails); E3 over-accepts (a negation-scope error passes). Adopting E3 as-is would silently remove the last forcing function that sends a human to the F1 clause, without putting any scope check in its place.

measurement_5_NEW_instrument_governance_.finding: The acceptance pipeline is only half hash-bound. artifacts/formulation/tools/run_acceptance.py IS in the FROZEN rev29 pin set and wires stage 2 to artifacts/worker-06/spec_conformance_audit.py, but that stage-2 rule engine has ZERO occurrences in artifacts/formulation/FROZEN.json and is therefore unpinned.
measurement_5_NEW_instrument_governance_.consequence: Every gate outcome that depends on stage 2 can be changed by editing an unpinned file while every pinned hash stays constant. Pin verification, which is this project's main defence, cannot detect it. This is the same failure class as CF-26/CF-29 (instrument moved during a freeze): in fact the CLASSSEP detector had to be mechanically restored from a hash-verified pin, and no such pin exists for stage 2.
measurement_5_NEW_instrument_governance_.why_it_binds_now: The R03 fix under discussion IS a stage-2 write. Under the current pin set, whichever R03 option is chosen, the resulting G-FORM/G-CLASSBIND evidence changes with no pinned byte moving - the change would be invisible to every existing audit.
measurement_5_NEW_instrument_governance_.recommendation: Any adopted R03 revision, and the stage-2 tool itself, must be pinned in a new FROZEN revision before it is used as gate evidence; the pin set should carry the stage-2 tool hash alongside run_acceptance.py.

measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.status: DECISION RECOMMENDED - requires controller authorization to execute
measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.decision: Do NOT adopt plain Option A (variable-wise) and do NOT adopt Option B (rewrite frozen F1). Recommend Option A-prime + pin.
measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.option_A_prime: Amend R03 to variable-wise binder matching AND add a scope-aware grouping requirement: a composite binder under a negated quantifier must be rendered as a single grouped term (literal '(q,t0)', or an equivalent bracketed grouping), so that a scope-error rendering fails. Add the scope-error variant from measurement_4 as a permanent negative control in the rule's selftest.
measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.reject_plain_option_A_because: measurement_4 shows it accepts a negation-scope error; it trades a false positive for a false negative in the one clause R03 exists to police.
measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.reject_option_B_because: it writes frozen F1 bytes, which voids the in-flight astra-life05-verify-gform-r3 review (lead-audit, deadline 02:45) and forces a re-freeze for a defect that is in the instrument, not in the class semantics. The class content is correct: ordered[5] kind=not_exists over the single binder '(q,t0)', and D5 defines exactly 'pairs (q,t0) with q a point of I+ and t0 in [0,T)'.
measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.residual_ambiguity_worth_recording: Even unfixed, the F1 quantifiers.formal rendering is genuinely scope-ambiguous in isolation; the structured fields (ordered[5] + D5) disambiguate it. This should be recorded as an unresolved_item on F1 rather than left implicit.
measurement_6_adjudication_decision_as_f.not_executed_because: no card authorizes a stage-2 write or a FROZEN revision in this pass; the evidence-binding-repair card explicitly forbade re-freezing anything outside its four named items, and CF-29 was an unauthorized instrument write. Recommendation is emitted as direction_update + blocker instead.
